steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
List. Open alerts, pending deploys and risks are stacked for the next engineer.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 2 handover items need action before the shift ends

findings.title: Open alert with no next step
findings.fix: Write the next step and its owner

findings.title: Pending deploy with no approval
findings.fix: Get the approval before the handover

pros: Flags an open alert with no next step, a pending deploy with no approval, and a risk with no owner.
cons: Not checked: Alerts not in the log.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-devops-on-call-handover skill on the records for this review.
